exposure: Group A: Exercise program with moderately restricted diet and insulin therapy
Group B: Moderately restricted diet and insulin therapy only (control group)
outcome: Neonatal Apgar scores at 1st and 5th minute of life
cohort: 60 pregnant women aged 25-35 years, with a BMI not exceeding 40 kg/m2 and diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus at 20-24 weeks of gestation.
finding: Antenatal exercise, in conjunction with a moderately restricted diet and insulin therapy, significantly decreased the rate of cesarean deliveries and improved neonatal Apgar scores compared to diet and insulin therapy alone in women with GDM.
mod_finding: Antenatal exercise significantly decreased the rate of cesarean deliveries.
